regions.full_page: Mr. & Mrs. X (Mrs. non-D.) of Indiana - enrolled a year ago & again .. away from confes. (he) for 28 yrs. She had been praying all the time that things would be right - in times of special trouble she would light 2 candles and pray before crucifix. His first marriage found nul & void, she became Catholic & they were married in Church - all receiving Holy Communion ... "The happiest man in America." .. . They had adopted two orphans and raised them in the faith.
